'''Ralakili''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who ran the [[droid]] [[fighting pit]]s in [[the Lodge]] on [[Vandor]]. Ralakili was a loathsome rascal who had [[Anti-droid sentiment|hated]] droids since his [[planet]] was ravaged by [[General]] [[Grievous]] during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Official Guide" /> In [[10 BBY]], Ralakili was confronted by [[L3-37]] who was [[Droid rights|protesting]] against the use of droids for entertainment in the pits.<ref name="Solo" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ralakili is a character created for the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. The character's name was first identified in the film's credits. Ralakili was played by [[Clint Howard]], brother of ''Solo'' director [[Ron Howard]].<ref name="Solo" />
